name: gui-screen
description: Screenshot capture for KDE Plasma/Wayland: spectacle first, then grim and gnome-screenshot fallbacks. Returns the PNG path for image-capable models.
use_when: seeing what is on the user's screen

args.name: backends
args.description: JSON map of available capture tools.

notes: Wayland: xdotool/scrot do not work. spectacle is the KDE-native path; --region opens an interactive picker.
